relationships.subject: anti-CGRP monoclonal antibodies
relationships.evidence_quote: there was a 33.3% decrease in MHDs per month from 19.8 at baseline to 13.2 at 12 months posttreatment

key_findings: In 14 chronic migraine patients with peripheral neuropathy, anti-CGRP mAbs reduced neuropathy pain scores 41.7% and migraine days 33.3% at 12 months (retrospective).
